remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946:. . . No signature. . . . Acquired by Whitney Museum of American Art 1958." Mentioned in 1934 New York (An American Place) exhibition review in *New York Times* (1934). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Overlapping geometric planes that resemble pieces of folded paper fill the frame. The shapes separate at the center to reveal a thin black line that runs the length of this narrow canvas.
